meta.name: CCNL Area Tessile-Moda e Chimica-Ceramica — Artigianato

family.reason: Craft textile and fashion businesses; the same text also covers craft chemistry and ceramics.

sources.title: SOURCE: kitech.it cited as accessible URL proxy; primary source is FEMCA CISL Bergamo salary sheet (local PDF, 4 tranches Jul 2024–Oct 2026) against which all values were verified.
SOURCE: EBER Allegato 2 'Sintesi codifica contratti INPS e CNEL' — CNEL code V751, INPS code 003. Cross-validated: acconciatura H515 matches repo.
SOURCE: Rinnovo signed 16 luglio 2024. Confirms Art. 68 Section 7 retribution 'Omissis' (unchanged from 2017 base). Apprentice seniority raised to 6.00 from 2025-01-01 for hires after 17 Jul 2024.
SOURCE: CNA PDF base CCNL 2017-12-14 — Art. 67 seniority amounts (per-level), Art. 68 apprenticeship percentages (3 gruppi, unchanged in 2024 rinnovo). Signatories from signature page.

notes.text: SALARY MODEL: conglobated (minimi tabellari conglobati). Back-calculation: L3 Jan 2025 = 1502.03/173 = 8.68 EUR/h; L4 Jan 2025 = 1566.69/173 = 9.05 EUR/h; L6 Jan 2025 = 1849.57/173 = 10.69 EUR/h — consistent divisor 173 across levels confirms conglobated model.

CNEL CODE: V751 confirmed from EBER (Ente Bilaterale Emilia-Romagna) 'Allegato 2 — Sintesi codifica contratti INPS e CNEL', INPS code 003. D025 found on lavoro-economia.it refers to the older separate 'Area Tessile-Moda' pre-unification entry; V751 covers the current unified area contract (tessile+chimica+ceramica).
TRANCHE DATES: four tranches — 2024-07-01 (retroactive from renewal 16 Jul 2024), 2025-01-01, 2025-10-01, 2026-10-01. Source: FEMCA CISL Bergamo salary sheet, cross-checked kitech.it.
HOURLY DIVISOR: 173, derived from 40-hour work week (Art. 9 CCNL tessile-moda artigianato). Formula: 40 h/week × 52/12 = 173.33 rounded to 173 per contract.
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 13 (tredicesima only). Source: ilccnl.it / CNA PDF art. mensilità aggiuntive.

SENIORITY: biennale (every 24 months), maximum 4 scatti. Per-level amounts from Art. 67 CNA PDF 2017 (primary source): 6S=15.49, 6=12.91, 5=10.85, 4=9.30, 3=8.26, 2=7.75, 1=7.23 EUR. Unchanged in 2024 rinnovo.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: raised from 5.16 to 6.00 EUR by 2024 rinnovo (Art. 25), effective 2025-01-01 for new hires after 17 Jul 2024. Modelled as uniform 6.00 from 2025-01-01 (pre-Jul-2024 hires staying at 5.16 not separately tracked — minor simplification for new engagements).

APPRENTICESHIP: 3 gruppi (Art. 68 CNA PDF 2017, Section 7 retribution marked 'Omissis' in 2024 rinnovo = unchanged). Gruppo 1 (destination levels 4-6S, max 54 months), Gruppo 2 (destination level 3, max 42 months), Gruppo 3 (destination level 2, max 24 months). Level 1 has no apprenticeship track.

Level 6S indennità di funzione (EUR 20.66) confirmed fixed across all four tranches. Verification 2026-09-09: web sources show L6S minimi (without indennità) as 1922.59/1975.32/2039.91/2112.41 (Jul 2024/Jan 2025/Oct 2025/Oct 2026); file stores 1943.25/1995.98/2060.57/2133.07 — difference exactly 20.66 EUR at every tranche (kitech.it Oct 2025 confirmation plus back-check against all 4 tranches). Indennità conglobata in base_salary (no separate fixed_allowances entry).

SUB-SECTORS (verbale integrativo of 22 July 2024, pp. 5-6): the chimica, concia, gomma, plastica and vetro table is modelled as the sub-sector chimica (the base_salary_by_subsector chimica of levels 1-6 and the chimica levels 5s and 7), the ceramica, terracotta, gres and decorazione di piastrelle table as the sub-sector ceramica (levels A-G), both by EmployerProfile.subsector. Not modelled: the calzaturiero, lavorazioni a mano e su misura, pulitintolavanderie and occhialeria tables of the same verbale. Level 6S requested with chimica, and levels 1-6S with ceramica, are paid the tessile table, which those sectors do not print; levels 1-6 of chimica take the tessile seniority amounts and apprenticeship tracks.

limitation.remediation: Model the other sector tables, source the seniority and apprenticeship of chimica and ceramica and reject the levels their tables lack, then remove this note.

notes.text: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: 5.16 EUR a biennium (Art. 67, p. 78) until 2024, 6.00 from 1 January 2025 (renewal of 16 July 2024, p. 23, 'non rapportato alla percentuale di progressione retributiva'); the apprentices in service on 16 July 2024 keep the 5.16 (apprentice_cohort), read from the hire date of the employment.

LEVEL CATEGORY: all levels left null (no primary-source text confirming operaio/impiegato split). The 2026-artigianato.json tier applies the impiegato rate (0.2471) for category='impiegato'/'quadro' vs. default 0.2693. Employer cost for higher levels (5, 6, 6S) may be slightly overestimated until categories are confirmed from primary CCNL text.

limitation.remediation: Confirm the operaio/impiegato category of each level from the CCNL text.

notes.text: INPS RATES: the employer and worker INPS rates of the sector (artigianato) are totals no 2026 INPS or association table confirms: the only component split found is the INPS guide of 2012 and the 2026 totals come from a software house page that does not prove its year. The contributions of every run rest on them.

limitation.remediation: Source the artigianato rates of 2026 on an INPS or association table, mark the inps block of contribution/2026/artigianato.json derived, then remove this note.

notes.text: APPRENTICE INPS RATES (artigianato): 10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus the 1.61% NASpI and integrativo, 11.61% for the employer (3.11% and 4.61% in the first two years of a firm up to 9 employees) and 5.84% for the worker. The 0.91 reduction of the artisan employers does not apply to apprentices: 'sul contributo per gli apprendisti non trovano applicazione le riduzioni del cuneo contributivo di cui alle leggi n. 388/2000 e n. 266/2005' (INPS circ. 140/2012 par. 3.3, https://servizi2.inps.it/servizi/Bussola/VisualizzaDoc.aspx?sVirtualURL=/Circolari/Circolare%20numero%20140%20del%2014-12-2012.htm, sha256 67d04317e66825fdb2cf6aa0b3106e644d76461e3e6ec17cd456b307948701a7). The wage-integration contribution of the sector is the FSBA, paid outside INPS (F24, code EBNA), not part of the INPS employer rate.

SUB-SECTOR RULES (chimica and ceramica, art. 67-68, stesura 16 July 2024 pp. 89-95): their five biennial increments (seniority_increments_by_subsector) and three apprenticeship groups each (tracks naming the sub-sector) are modelled; apprentices 6 EUR per increment from 2025. Not modelled: the track of the impiegati amministrativi of all sectors (3 years, 70-90%), the fixed allowances of the sub-sector levels (such as the indennità di funzione of 6S), and their category, left to Employment.category.

limitation.remediation: Model the impiegati amministrativi track by category and the allowances of the sub-sector levels.

reviews.scope: base_salary of levels 1-6 and 6S, all four tranches (2024-07-01, 2025-01-01, 2025-10-01, 2026-10-01), against the Settore tessile abbigliamento table of the Verbale integrativo of 22 July 2024 published by Filctem CGIL (signatory).
findings: Levels 1-6: all 24 periods match the 'Nuovi minimi contrattuali' table of the Settore tessile abbigliamento (Verbale integrativo 22 July 2024, p. 2, scanned PDF read by OCR and visual check) except level 5 from 2026-10-01: the table prints 1.813,56 (1.751,06 + the printed increment 62,50), the file had 1813.50.

Level 6S: the file stores the printed 6s minimo plus the quadri indennità di funzione of EUR 20,66 (art. 119 CCNL 14 Dec 2017; 6° super = quadri per art. 29). All four periods equal printed minimo + 20.66 and are recorded as derived on the CCNL text; the indennità is not repeated in the 2024 renewal and is assumed unchanged.
The minimi are conglobated tabellare amounts (single 'Retribuzione tabellare' column, no separate contingenza or EDR), consistent with the file's conglobated model.

The file models only the Settore tessile abbigliamento table. The same verbale prints distinct tables for calzaturiero (from 2026-10-01 and for level 6/6s already from 2024), lavorazioni a mano e su misura, pulitintolavanderie, occhialeria, chimica-concia-gomma-plastica-vetro and ceramica; those are not modelled.

reviews.scope: The sick pay and the comporto of the CCNL (work_rules.sickness_rules), read on the signed text.
findings: Art. 109 (pp. 126-127), operai Tessile, Abbigliamento, Calzaturiero: 80% for days 1-7, the first 3 not paid for an illness under 8 days, 100% of the net pay for days 8-180; Art. 97 (p. 116): 12 months. The file had a flat 80% and no carenza: corrected. Art. 97 holds both a 21-month and a 24-month paragraph on several illnesses, so no window is stored (note).

reviews.scope: The Nuovi minimi contrattuali of the chimica, concia, gomma, plastica, vetro (p. 5) and ceramica, terracotta, gres, decorazione di piastrelle (p. 6) tables of the verbale integrativo of 22 July 2024, page images.
findings: Chimica (p. 5): the 32 minimi of levels 1-7 and 5s for 1 July 2024, 1 January 2025, 1 October 2025 and 1 October 2026 read on the page image and added as the base_salary_by_subsector chimica of levels 1-6 and the chimica levels 5s and 7.
Ceramica (p. 6): the 28 minimi of levels A-G for the same four tranches read on the page image and added as the ceramica levels A-G.

reviews.scope: FSBA ordinary contribution, art. 3 of the 2024 regulation, read on the text layer (analysis by a separate model session).
findings: Added parameters.solidarity_fund FSBA: 0.45%+0.15% up to 15 employees, 0.75%+0.25% above, on the INPS base, fixed terms included.

reviews.scope: Art. 67 and 68 of the stesura of 16 July 2024 (pp. 89-90, 94-96), tables read on the page images.
findings: Added the increments and the apprenticeship tracks of the chimica and ceramica sub-sectors.

reviews.scope: INPS circ. 140/2012 par. 3.3 on the apprentice contribution, against the research of a separate model session.
findings: The cuneo reductions (0.91) do not apply to apprentices: the artigianato apprentice rates of the bundle are confirmed.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

location.section: Art. 97 (Conservazione del posto, Area Tessile/Moda), Art. 109 (Trattamento economico per malattia, operai Tessile/Moda)
location.quote: Per il Settore Tessile, Abbigliamento, Calzaturiero: - l'80% della retribuzione normale di fatto dal 1° al 7° giorno d'assenza. Tale trattamento non verrà corrisposto nei primi 3 giorni d'assenza per malattia di durata inferiore a 8 giorni di calendario; - il 100% della retribuzione normale di fatto netta dall'8° al 180° giorno d'assenza. Tale trattamento verrà corrisposto dal 1° giorno d'assenza qualora la malattia superi i 21 giorni di calendario. [...] Al lavoratore ammalato, non in prova, sarà conservato il posto, con decorrenza dell'anzianità a tutti gli effetti contrattuali, per un periodo di 12 (dodici) mesi.

provenance.transformation: Art. 109, operai of Tessile, Abbigliamento, Calzaturiero: 80% for days 1-7 (the carenza days 1-3 at 80% only when the illness lasts 8 days or more: carenza_min_days 7), 100% of the net pay for days 8-180 (net_basis), no integration from day 181; Art. 97: the job is kept for 12 months of one illness (365 days, months of 365/12 days). The file had a flat 80% and no carenza. Read on 2026-10-31 on the OCR of the signed scan, checked on the page images.
provenance.note: Not modelled: 'Tale trattamento verrà corrisposto dal 1° giorno d'assenza qualora la malattia superi i 21 giorni di calendario': an illness of more than 21 days is paid 100% net from day 1, the engine pays days 1-7 at 80% (underpaid); the 80% of days 1-7 is of the gross 'retribuzione normale di fatto', the engine takes every rate on the net basis, so the INPS share of days 4-7 is grossed up. Art. 97 holds two paragraphs on several illnesses, 'ove nell'arco di 21 mesi si raggiunga il limite predetto anche con più malattie' and, further down, the same paragraph with 'nell'arco di 24 mesi'; the text does not say which holds, so no window is stored (limitation sickness_cumulation_window). The bundle holds one rule: the impiegati, intermedi and quadri of Art. 118 (the whole pay for 3 months and half for 3 more up to 10 years of seniority, 4 and 6 above; Occhialeria 100% for days 1-180), the operai of Pulitintolavanderia (80% days 1-8, 100% net days 9-180) and Occhialeria (80% days 1-20, 100% net days 21-180, from day 1 past 28 days) and the Area Chimica/Ceramica (Art. 98) are paid as the operai of Tessile, Abbigliamento, Calzaturiero. The 12 more months of an oncological illness or grave infermità in 24 months and the 90 more days of a disability certified under L. 68/1999.
